title: 日本建築史
subtitle: History of Japanese Architecture
educationalGoal: Students learn the history of Japanese architecture from ancient to modern times and understand its architectural design and technical features, space composition, social background, and regionality. They learn about the role and characteristics of architecture and streets.
advice:
Students learn about temple architecture, shrine architecture, and residential architecture from ancient to modern Japan.

1. History of residential buildings and cities, townscapes.

2. Ancient temples and shrines.

3. Medieval temples and shrines.

4. Early modern temples and shrines.

5. Modern temples and shrines.
requiredKnowledge: Students must have an interest in Japanese history, art history, archeology, folklore, etc., and try to understand Japanese architecture and architectural culture from a broad perspective.

activityGoals.body: Students understand the history of Japanese architecture and summarize key points.
Students can learn by themselves and write their own considerations.
Students can research historical Japanese architecture and explain its characteristics.
